segment.description: Covington First Baptist Church Pond, Covington (Tipton County), TN — a NEW addition to TWRA's 2025-26 winter rainbow trout stocking program. TWRA's 11/26/2025 press release names 'the Covington First Baptist Church pond (Tipton County)' as one of two new program sites; TWRA's live stocking table lists 'Covington First Baptist Church Pond (NEW)' (Region 1, Tipton County) with Winter-type rainbow trout stockings on 1/15/2026 and 'TBD 12/2026'.
segment.boundaries: Entire church pond at First Baptist Church, Covington, Tipton County, TN; TWRA Region 1 winter stocking program site (cold-window stockings only).

coldSource.notes: No cold-water source evidence found. Sister Tipton County winter-program pond (Valentine Park, Covington) rows in the same TWRA table confirm the local program pattern.

holdover.detail: No site-level holdover documentation found; the site is new to the program as of 2025-26, so no holdover history exists to document. Program-level context: TWRA's Trout Management Plan 2017-2027 states hatchery-supported waters 'are primarily warmwater habitats that cannot support trout year round.'

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout record for this pond. TWRA Trout Management Plan 2017-2027: 'Wild trout are generally limited to East Tennessee's mountain streams.'

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: A newly added (2025-26) TWRA winter put-and-take pond — rainbows stocked only in the winter program (1/15/2026 + TBD 12/2026 rows) — in a county where TWRA's plan says warmwater hatchery-supported waters cannot support trout year round.

sourcesChecked: https://www.tn.gov/twra/news.html (miss: release list is JS-rendered; 12/31/2025 winter-program-continues release not retrievable at a verified URL)
